bead.title: concerns: reconcile .golangci.yml with declared go-std lint baseline (decide: restore linters vs amend concern)
bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. .ddx/plugins/helix/workflows/concerns/go-std/practices.md declares a golangci-lint baseline that includes govet, staticcheck, ineffassign, misspell, unconvert, gosec, gocritic. The repo's .golangci.yml enables only misspell. Makefile runs go vet, gosec, govulncheck, go test -race pre-push, which provides partial coverage but is not what the concern names.

Resolution: open decision (see AR Open Decisions §1). Either restore the declared linters to .golangci.yml or amend the go-std concern override in docs/helix/01-frame/concerns.md to ratify the Makefile-driven path.

Source review: fizeau-a1b61f00.
bead.acceptance: Either (a) .golangci.yml enables the declared go-std linter set with the project's accepted exclusions, AND golangci-lint runs in CI; or (b) docs/helix/01-frame/concerns.md §go-std contains an override paragraph documenting the Makefile-driven equivalent and naming each tool that replaces each declared linter. The artifact is internally consistent.
